create_dense_flat_indexer: create a DenseFlatIndexer to build an exact search FAISS index with inner product metric
index_data_flat: index numpy array vectors into a DenseFlatIndexer using batched indexing for exact search
search_knn_flat: search for top-k nearest neighbor vectors in a DenseFlatIndexer using inner product scores
create_hnsw_indexer: create a DenseHNSWFlatIndexer to build an approximate search index with configurable efSearch and efConstruction
serialize_deserialize_index: serialize a FAISS index to disk or deserialize it back using the DenseIndexer base class methods
